(Los Angeles, California) | college = [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia]] (2013–2017) | draft_year = 2017 | career_start = 2017 | years1 = {{nbay|2017|full=y}} | team1 = [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] | years2 = 2017–2018 | team2 = →[[Canton Charge]] | years3 = 2018 | team3 = [[Limoges CSP|Limoges]] | years4 = 2018–2019 | team4 = [[Cholet Basket|Cholet]] | years5 = 2019–2020 | team5 = [[Bahçeşehir Koleji S.K.|Bahçeşehir]] | years6 = 2020 | team6 = [[Capital City Go-Go]] | years7 = [[2020–21 NBA G League season|2021]] | team7 = [[Austin Spurs]] | years8 = 2021–2023 | team8 = [[Hapoel Gilboa Galil]] | years9 = 2023–2025 | team9 = [[Kolossos Rodou B.C.|Kolossos Rodou]] | years10 = 2025–present | team10 = [[Maroussi B.C.|Maroussi]] | highlights = *Second-team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]] (2017) }} '''London Tyus Perrantes Jr.''' (born October 3, 1994) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[Maroussi B.C.|Maroussi]] of the [[Greek Basketball League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia Cavaliers]], where he was selected [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC Second Team]] during his senior season. Perrantes went undrafted in the [[2017 NBA draft]] and played one season for the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]], with whom he reached the [[2018 NBA Finals]]. ==High school career== Perrantes attended [[Crespi Carmelite High School]], where he was coached by Russell White. Perrantes developed his signature calm, deliberate playing style after competing against older players. He was noticed by [[Washington State Cougars football|Washington State]] football player Nico Grasu, who alerted the university's basketball coach, [[Tony Bennett (basketball, born 1969)|Tony Bennett]]. When Bennett was hired by Virginia, Perrantes committed to play for him, turning down an offer from [[USC Trojans men's basketball|USC]] after [[Kevin O'Neill (basketball)|Kevin O'Neill]] was released as coach.{{cite news|last1=Helfand|first1=Zach|title=London Perrantes is 'Cali cool' in steering the Virginia Cavaliers' offense|url=http://www.latimes.com/sports/la-sp-virginia-perrantes-ncaa-20160323-story.html|access-date=September 20, 2016|work=[[Los Angeles Times]]|date=March 22, 2016}} As a senior, he averaged 19.9 points and 5.8 assists per game and was named ''L.A. Daily News'' Player of the Year and ''L.A. Times'' All-Area First Team. He was ranked No. 86 on ESPN's Top 100 recruiting list for 2013.{{cite web|title=32 London Perrantes|url=http://www.virginiasports.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/london_perrantes_849797.html|website=[[Virginia Cavaliers]]|access-date=September 20, 2016|archive-date=November 18, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171118234748/http://www.virginiasports.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/london_perrantes_849797.html|url-status=dead}} ==College career== As a freshman, Perrantes helped lead Virginia to the NCAA Tournament's Sweet 16 for the first time in 19 years while starting 33 games and shooting 44% from behind the arc.{{cite news|last1=McNally|first1=Brian|title=Freshman London Perrantes has quickly become a major player for Virginia|url=http://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2014/mar/26/freshman-london-perrantes-has-quickly-become-major/|access-date=September 20, 2016|work=[[Washington Times]]|date=March 26, 2014}} On the season, he averaged 5.5 points and a team-high 3.8 assists per game. He was suspended the first game of his sophomore season for violating undisclosed team rules.{{cite news|last1=Giannotto|first1=Mark|title=Virginia basketball suspends Evan Nolte, London Perrantes for opener at JMU|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/colleges/virginia-basketball-suspends-evan-nolte-london-perrantes-for-opener-at-jmu/2014/11/07/bcf7bb8a-66d1-11e4-9fdc-d43b053ecb4d_story.html|access-date=September 20, 2016|newspaper=[[Washington Post]]|date=November 7, 2014}} He scored a career-high 26 points in a match against [[Miami Hurricanes men's basketball|Miami]] on January 1, 2015. Perrantes broke his nose and suffered a mild concussion after colliding with [[Malcolm Brogdon]] in a win against [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State]] on February 22.{{cite news|last1=Goodman|first1=Jeff|title=London Perrantes day-to-day|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/12369797/virginia-cavaliers-guard-london-perrantes-meet-doctors|access-date=September 20, 2016|work=[[ESPN]]|date=February 23, 2015}} He averaged 6.4 points and 4.6 assists per game as a sophomore, helping to propel the Cavaliers to a 30–4 record and second straight [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] regular-season title.{{cite news|last1=Wood|first1=Norm|title=U.Va.'s London Perrantes stays true to point guard basics, but knows he has to shoot more|url=http://www.dailypress.com/sports/uva/dp-spt-virginia-mens-basketball-media-day-1022-20151021-story.html|access-date=September 20, 2016|work=[[Daily Press (Virginia)|The Daily Press]]|date=October 21, 2015}} [[File:London Perrantes in NCAA Tournament.jpg|thumb|left|Perrantes in the 2016 NCAA Tournament]] As a junior, Perrantes became more of a vocal leader on the team, identifying himself as the player who picked the team up when it was dragging.{{cite news|last1=Wallace|first1=Ava|title=London Perrantes is Virginia's fiery, laid-back leader|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/colleges/london-perrantes-is-virginias-fiery-laid-back-leader/2016/02/08/a243862c-ceac-11e5-abc9-ea152f0b9561_story.html|access-date=September 20, 2016|newspaper=[[Washington Post]]|date=February 8, 2016}} He hit a career-high seven three-pointers to go along with 22 points in a loss to [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech]] on January 4, 2016.{{cite news|title=Zach LeDay helps Virginia Tech hold off No. 4 Virginia|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400839816|access-date=September 20, 2016|work=[[ESPN]]|date=January 5, 2016}} Perrantes scored 16 points with four 3-pointers in a 73–65 win against [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse]] on January 24.{{cite news|last1=Bender|first1=Bill|title=London Perrantes has Virginia's offense rising faster than his hair for Elite Eight|url=http://www.sportingnews.com/ncaa-basketball/news/london-perrantes-hair-virginia-cavaliers-elite-eight-vs-syracuse-tournament/15t19jgth60nu1439crgs8sia8|access-date=September 20, 2016|work=[[Sporting News]]|date=March 27, 2016}} Perrantes averaged 11.0 points, 4.4 assists and 3.0 rebounds per game, shooting 43.9 percent from the field, 48.8 percent from 3-point range and 80.3 percent from the free-throw line. He was named honorable mention All-ACC by the media and coaches. "He just stirred the pot," coach Bennett said of Perrantes in 2016. "He made everything kind of work out. He got guys the ball. He understood it." As a senior, Perrantes was named to the Second Team All-Atlantic Coast Conference.{{cite news|url=http://www.theacc.com/news/acc-announces-all-conference-team-postseason-awards-03-05-2017|title=ACC Announces All-Conference Team, Postseason Awards, All-ACC Teams|publisher=theacc.com|author=Press Release|date=March 5, 2017|access-date=June 23, 2017|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170306210527/http://www.theacc.com/news/acc-announces-all-conference-team-postseason-awards-03-05-2017|archive-date=March 6, 2017}} His season ended with a 65–39 loss to [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]] in the NCAA Tournament. Perrantes averaged 12.7 points and 3.8 assists per game. He tied a program record with 138 games played and scored 1,225 points in his Virginia career.{{cite news|last1=Stubbs|first1=Roman|title=An abrupt ending for London Perrantes, but the rest of Virginia expects to be back |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/colleges/an-abrupt-ending-for-london-perrantes-but-the-rest-of-virginia-expects-to-be-back/2017/03/19/f939a3ca-0cb4-11e7-ab07-07d9f521f6b5_story.html |access-date=June 23, 2017|newspaper=[[The Washington Post]]|date=March 19, 2017}} ==Professional career== After going undrafted in the [[2017 NBA draft]], Perrantes signed a summer league deal with the [[Miami Heat]].{{cite news|last1=Winderman|first1=Ira|url=http://www.sun-sentinel.com/sports/miami-heat/fl-sp-miami-heat-nba-draft-second-round-s20170622-story.html|title=Miami Heat stock up after Pat Riley bypasses second-round pick in NBA draft|access-date=June 23, 2017|work=[[The Sun-Sentinel]]|date=June 23, 2017}} On August 23, 2017, Perrantes signed with the [[San Antonio Spurs]].{{cite news|title=SPURS SIGN LONDON PERRANTES|url=http://www.nba.com/spurs/spurs-sign-london-perrantes|work=nba.com|date=August 23, 2017|access-date=August 23, 2017}} He was waived before the season began on October 12, 2017. On October 18, 2017, Perrantes signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]].{{cite web|title=SPURS WAIVE AMIDA BRIMAH AND LONDON PERRANTES|url=http://www.nba.com/spurs/spurs-waive-amida-brimah-and-london-perrantes|website=NBA.com|date=October 12, 2017|access-date=October 12, 2017}} That meant throughout the rest of that season, he had split his playing time between the Cavaliers and their [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[Canton Charge]]. Perrantes would make his NBA debut on December 12, playing three minutes in a 123–114 win over the [[Atlanta Hawks]]. The Cavaliers made it to the [[2018 NBA Finals]], but lost 4–0 to the [[Golden State Warriors]]. On June 12, 2018, Perrantes was waived by the Cavaliers.{{cite news |title=London Perrantes: Waived by Cavs |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/london-perrantes-waived-by-cavs/ |access-date=June 13, 2018 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=June 12, 2018}} On July 23, 2018, Perrantes signed a one-year deal with French side [[Limoges CSP|Limoges]].{{cite news|title=Limoges adds London Perrantes|url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/eurocup/716622/limoges-adds-london-perrantes/|work=Eurohoops|date=July 23, 2018|access-date=October 13, 2018}} On November 16, 2018, Perrantes was released by [[Limoges CSP]].{{cite web|last1=Askounis|first1=John|title=Limoges replaces London Perrantes with Jordan Taylor|url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/eurocup/776178/limoges-replaces-london-perrantes-with-jordan-taylor/|website=Eurohoops|access-date=June 15, 2019|date=November 16, 2018}} On November 18, 2018, Perrantes joined [[Cholet Basket]].{{cite news|last1=Carchia|first1=Emiliano|title=London Perrantes signs with Cholet Basket|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/london-perrantes-signs-with-cholet-basket/|website=Sportando|access-date=June 15, 2019|date=November 18, 2018}} On June 25, 2019, Perrantes joined the [[New Orleans Pelicans]] for the [[2019 NBA Summer League]]. On September 12, 2019, Perrantes joined the [[Portland Trail Blazers]] for training camp,{{cite web|title=TRAIL BLAZERS SIGN THREE PLAYERS, ANNOUNCE TRAINING CAMP ROSTER|url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/2019/9/12/blazers-announce-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|access-date=September 13, 2019|date=September 12, 2019}} but was later waived by the Trail Blazers on October 18.{{cite web|title=TRAIL BLAZERS WAIVE BLEVINS, CAUPAIN AND PERRANTES|url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/2019/10/18/blazers-waive-blevins-caupain-perrantes|date=October 18, 2019|website=NBA.com|access-date=October 18, 2019}} On November 11, 2019, Perrantes joined the [[Bahçeşehir Koleji S.K.|Bahçeşehir Basketbol]].{{cite web|title=LONDON PERRANTES MEDICAL PARK GÖZTEPE HASTANE KOMPLEKSİ'NDE KONTROLDEN GEÇTİ|language=TR|url=https://www.bahcesehirsporkulubu.org/haberler/london-perrantes-medical-park-goztepe-hastane-kompleksi-nde-kontrolden-gecti|date=November 11, 2019|website=bahcesehirsporkulubu.org|access-date=November 11, 2019|archive-date=November 12, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191112015834/https://www.bahcesehirsporkulubu.org/haberler/london-perrantes-medical-park-goztepe-hastane-kompleksi-nde-kontrolden-gecti|url-status=dead}} On January 21, 2020, the [[Capital City Go-Go]] announced that they had acquired Perrantes from Canton Charge in exchange for the returning right to [[Gabe York]].{{cite web|first1=Kelly|last1=Rakusin|title=GO-GO ACQUIRE LONDON PERRANTES|url=https://capitalcity.gleague.nba.com/news/go-go-acquire-london-perrantes|date=January 21, 2020|website=NBA.com|access-date=January 21, 2020}} On December 18, 2020, Perrantes was signed by the [[San Antonio Spurs]],{{Cite web|last=Garcia|first=Jeff|date=December 19, 2020|title=Spurs sign G London Perrantes to Exhibit-10 deal|url=https://news4sanantonio.com/sports/spurs-zone/spurs-sign-g-london-perrantes-to-exhibit-10-deal|access-date=December 21, 2020|website=NEWS4SA}} and was then waived the next day.{{Cite web|last=Hill|first=Arthur|date=December 20, 2020|title=Spurs Waive London Perrantes|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2020/12/spurs-waive-london-perrantes.html|access-date=December 21, 2020|website=Hoopsrumors}} He was then added to the Spurs' G League affiliate, the [[Austin Spurs]]. On August 22, 2021, he signed with [[Hapoel Gilboa Galil]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League|Israeli Premier League]].{{Cite news|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/hapoel-galil-gilboa-lands-london-perrantes/|title=Hapoel Galil Gilboa lands London Perrantes|last=|first=|date=August 22, 2021|website=|newspaper=Sportando|language=En|access-date=August 22, 2021 |last1=Skerletic |first1=Dario }} During the 2022–2023 season, he averaged 11.8 points, 3.2 rebounds and 6.6 assists in 19 games. On August 8, 2023, Perrantes moved to Greek club [[Kolossos Rodou B.C.|Kolossos Rodou]], where he spent the following two seasons.
